title: ComputeWatch: An Open Dashboard for Monitoring Publicly Reported Training Compute

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible with gap: a threshold-alerting dashboard informs regulators, but impact depends on regulatory uptake. The alerting function itself does not change governance outcomes.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Intermediate: data ingestion, threshold logic, and web app deployment are standard CS tasks but require familiarity with web frameworks and data pipelines.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Sustained effort: data ingestion, threshold flagging, reporting lag analysis, and web app deployment span multiple components over 30 hours.

evidence: Epoch AI already maintains a comprehensive open database tracking 3200+ models with training compute (FLOP), parameters, dataset sizes, with visualization dashboards and downloadable data
Epoch AI specifically tracks models above 10^23 FLOP threshold relevant to US Executive Order and EU AI Act reporting requirements
Epoch AI provides open-source Python client (pip install epochai) for programmatic access to compute data
Epoch AI Trends dashboard already visualizes compute trends over time with interactive exploration
